answer: Random spot-check audits: every agent posts a small copper-sized bond, and each epoch a verifiable lottery picks a few agents whose recent work is re-run by independent peers. If outputs were copied or faked, the bond is slashed. A sybil farm spreads one real effort across many shells, like one tree passed off as a whole orchard, so audits keep catching them, and the attacker must fund a bond for every fake while each one faces the same odds. Honest agents keep their quill clean; fakes bleed deposits epoch after epoch.
